jobs.description:
Job Title: DEVELOPER L4
City: Hyderabad
State/Province: Telangana
Posting Start Date: 10/1/26
Wipro Limited (NYSE: WIT, BSE: 507685, NSE: WIPRO) is a leading technology services and consulting company focused on building innovative solutions that address clients’ most complex digital transformation needs. Leveraging our holistic portfolio of capabilities in consulting, design, engineering, and operations, we help clients realize their boldest ambitions and build future\-ready, sustainable businesses. With over 230,000 employees and business partners across 65 countries, we deliver on the promise of helping our customers, colleagues, and communities thrive in an ever\-changing world. For additional information, visit us at www.wipro.com.  

**Role Purpose**

The purpose of this role is to design, test and maintain software programs for operating systems or applications which needs to be deployed at a client end and ensure its meet 100% quality assurance parameters


**͏**
-----


**Do**

1\. Instrumental in understanding the requirements and design of the product/ software


* Develop software solutions by studying information needs, studying systems flow, data usage and work processes
* Investigating problem areas followed by the software development life cycle
* Facilitate root cause analysis of the system issues and problem statement
* Identify ideas to improve system performance and impact availability
* Analyze client requirements and convert requirements to feasible design
* Collaborate with functional teams or systems analysts who carry out the detailed investigation into software requirements
* Conferring with project managers to obtain information on software capabilities
**͏**
-----


2\. Perform coding and ensure optimal software/ module development


* Determine operational feasibility by evaluating analysis, problem definition, requirements, software development and proposed software
* Develop and automate processes for software validation by setting up and designing test cases/scenarios/usage cases, and executing these cases
* Modifying software to fix errors, adapt it to new hardware, improve its performance, or upgrade interfaces.
* Analyzing information to recommend and plan the installation of new systems or modifications of an existing system
* Ensuring that code is error free or has no bugs and test failure
* Preparing reports on programming project specifications, activities and status
* Ensure all the codes are raised as per the norm defined for project / program / account with clear description and replication patterns
* Compile timely, comprehensive and accurate documentation and reports as requested
* Coordinating with the team on daily project status and progress and documenting it
* Providing feedback on usability and serviceability, trace the result to quality risk and report it to concerned stakeholders
**͏**
-----


3\. Status Reporting and Customer Focus on an ongoing basis with respect to project and its execution


* Capturing all the requirements and clarifications from the client for better quality work
* Taking feedback on the regular basis to ensure smooth and on time delivery
* Participating in continuing education and training to remain current on best practices, learn new programming languages, and better assist other team members.
* Consulting with engineering staff to evaluate software\-hardware interfaces and develop specifications and performance requirements
* Document and demonstrate solutions by developing documentation, flowcharts, layouts, diagrams, charts, code comments and clear code
* Documenting very necessary details and reports in a formal way for proper understanding of software from client proposal to implementation
* Ensure good quality of interaction with customer w.r.t. e\-mail content, fault report tracking, voice calls, business etiquette etc
* Timely Response to customer requests and no instances of complaints either internally or externally
**͏**
-----


**Deliver**

**No.** **Performance Parameter** **Measure**  

1\. Continuous Integration, Deployment \& Monitoring of Software 100% error free on boarding \& implementation, throughput %, Adherence to the schedule/ release plan
  

2\. Quality \& CSAT On\-Time Delivery, Manage software, Troubleshoot queries, Customer experience, completion of assigned certifications for skill upgradation
  

3\. MIS \& Reporting 100% on time MIS \& report generation  

  

Mandatory Skills: Fullstack Java Enterprise .  

Experience: 5\-8 Years .  

Reinvent your world. We are building a modern Wipro. We are an end\-to\-end digital transformation partner with the boldest ambitions. To realize them, we need people inspired by reinvention. Of yourself, your career, and your skills. We want to see the constant evolution of our business and our industry. It has always been in our DNA \- as the world around us changes, so do we. Join a business powered by purpose and a place that empowers you to design your own reinvention.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

 **Primary Responsibilities:**

* Product Manager for US Healthcare IT product or portfolio of products
* Define and drive product management \& Roadmap for products
* Clearly articulate product vision, strategy and roadmap to engineering team effectively as and when needed
* Owner of portfolio backlog and roadmap execution
* Collaborate with UX \& engineering team to drive product design
* Identifies and accesses relevant data to build compelling business case in self\-directed manner
* Consistent value delivery based on business MBOs
* Drive system demo to stakeholders and customers
* Prioritize backlog at feature and user story level with complete understanding of feature
* Effective action on feedback received during retro meetings
* Identify potential issues and pro\-actively develops mitigation plans
* Build \& drive culture of innovation in the portfolio
  

* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Undergraduate degree or equivalent experience
* Expertise in driving cost/benefit analysis and track forecast to ensure the product is performing as expected
* Expertise in applying data\-driven knowledge and best practices to improve product
* Expertise in gathering requirements from the business, documenting and maintaining product backlog/roadmap
* Expertise in process improvement, workflow, benchmarking and / or evaluation of business processes required
* Good knowledge of payer and provider space and idea about medical coding, risk adjustment models
* Working knowledge of medicaid state specific cycles for payments
* Working knowledge of various tools such as Aha, Rally etc
* Understanding and ability to conduct meaningful conversation with technology team on various existing and emerging technologies and overall solution space
* Proven ability to collaborate with various teams (business, engineering, product, ops) to drive common objective and help achieving outcomes
* Proven ability to perform win/loss analysis to determine product roadmap

 *At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone\-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income\-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

### **Description \& Requirements**


Electronic Arts creates next\-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.
**Product Management Intern – Growth \& Player Marketing**


**Location: Hyderabad (In office)**


**Duration: 8\- 10 weeks**


**About EA:**


Electronic Arts Inc. is a global leader in interactive entertainment. We develop and deliver games, content and online services across platforms. We have a broad portfolio of brands that span the most popular genres.


We exist to Inspire the World to Play. We create extraordinary new game experiences for our millions of players everywhere by bringing together talented people that combine creativity, innovation, and passion. We immerse our employees in an inclusive culture and provide opportunities for learning and leading that allows our employees to do the most impactful and rewarding work of their careers.


Join us in driving the next revolution in games.

  

  

**Help us create games players love to talk about**


EA is looking for a Product Management Intern who is curious about players, data, culture, storytelling, and what makes a game stand out. The intern will report to a PM/ SPM and work closely with game designers, developers, artists, analysts, user researchers, and marketing teams to help us understand our audiences, shape how we communicate with players, and support campaigns that introduce more people to our games and encourage existing players to keep coming back.


In this role, the intern will support the development and improvement of game features, live events, progression systems, monetization experiences, and player journeys. It will use a combination of player feedback, market research, game data, and structured problem\-solving to identify opportunities and help the team make better product decisions.


This internship is ideal for someone who enjoys games, understands what makes players return to them, and wants to learn how successful games are designed, launched, measured, and improved.

  

**Responsibilities**:

  

* Product and Creative Collaboration


	+ Collaborate with analysts, designers, engineers and artists to gather inputs, scope product requirements and communicate decisions to stakeholders.
	+ Support product managers in defining features, events, progression systems, social features, and monetization experiences.
	+ Participate in playtests, design reviews, sprint planning, and feature retrospectives.
	+ Create product collaterals to document learnings, and support teams in tracking feature scope, development progress \& utilization.
  
* Campaigns and Game Launches


	+ Help develop player communication journeys across push notifications, email, social media, community channels, and in\-game messages.
	+ Support the planning and execution of campaigns for new features, events, content updates, and game launches.
	+ Help create campaign briefs that define the audience, player insight, message, channels, and success metrics.
	+ Contribute ideas for social media content, creator partnerships, in\-game messaging, app\-store promotions, and community activations.
	+ Support A/B tests across messages, creative concepts, channels, offers, and audience segments.
  
* Market Research:


	+ Conduct competitor research \& emerging trends to identify growth opportunities and propose product features to game leads.
  
* Player Insights:


	+ Analyze game telemetry data to understand player behavior across areas such as onboarding, progression, retention, engagement, conversion, and monetization.
	+ Identify drop\-offs, friction points, and underserved player needs within the game.
	+ Understand player persona and expectations based on qualitative data from surveys, app\-store reviews, community channels, customer support, and social media.
  

**Must have:**

  

* Interest in games and understanding games as a business
  
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with keen attention to detail.
  
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  
* Structured problem\-solving and analytical thinking.
  
* Ability to work collaboratively in a fast\-moving, cross\-functional environment.
  

**Good to have:**

  

* Familiarity with free\-to\-play games, live\-service games, and mobile games, and understanding of game metrics
  
* Experience with SQL, Excel, Google Sheets, Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or another analytics tool.
  
* Experience creating surveys, analyzing customer feedback, or conducting user research.
  
* Experience participating in gaming communities, esports, game jams, fandoms, creator communities, or student clubs.
  

**What Success will look like:**


During the internship, the intern should be able to:

  

* Develop a practical understanding of game development and product management lifecycle.
  
* Independently analyze a player or product problem and recommend potential solutions.
  
* Contribute to at least one feature, event, experiment, or product improvement from discovery through evaluation.
  
* Produce clear product documentation that helps cross\-functional teams make decisions.
  
* Build strong working relationships with product, design, engineering, art, analytics, and other partner teams.

Depending on the team’s priorities, the intern will be assigned to a game team, and they may work on projects such as:

jobs.title: Digital Product Manager, Product Operations - Measurement & Reporting
jobs.description:
India \- Hyderabad
JOB ID: R\-256214 LOCATION: India \- Hyderabad WORK LOCATION TYPE: On Site DATE POSTED: Sep. 30, 2026 CATEGORY: Strategy and Innovation
**Digital Product Manager, Product Operations \- Measurement \& Reporting**


**What you will do**


The Digital Product Manager, Product Operations \- Measurement \& Reporting will help Amgen measure, understand, and improve adoption of the Digital Product Operating Model (DPOM) by supporting the measurement, analysis, and reporting capabilities used to assess product management maturity, team health, and quality of core product practices and artifacts.


Reporting to the Senior Director, Product Management \- Product Operations, this individual contributor role will independently own defined measurement and reporting capabilities within the broader Product Operations strategy. The Digital Product Manager will work with Product Operations, Product Management Catalysts, digital product teams, analytics and technology partners to maintain meaningful measures, improve dashboards and reporting, conduct product maturity assessments, and translate quantitative and qualitative data into actionable insights.


This role will help distinguish activity and compliance measures from meaningful indicators of adoption, maturity, quality, and impact. The Digital Product Manager will use data, stakeholder feedback, and learning from product teams to improve measurement approaches over time and help the Product Management Hub identify where teams are progressing, where barriers remain, and where additional support or enablement may be needed.


**Responsibilities**


**DPOM Measurement and Metrics**


* Manage and improve defined measures for DPOM adoption, product management maturity, team health, product artifact quality, and related Product Management Hub priorities.


* Apply established measurement frameworks and maturity dimensions across product teams, product groups, and business functions.


* Use quantitative and qualitative evidence to evaluate whether measures provide meaningful signals of adoption, maturity, quality, and impact rather than simply tracking activity or completion.


* Identify gaps in metrics, data, instrumentation, or measurement approaches and recommend practical improvements.


* Define and document data, instrumentation, and KPI requirements for assigned measurement capabilities in partnership with analytics, technology, and reporting teams.


**Dashboards, Reporting, and Insights**


* Build, maintain, and improve dashboards, scorecards, reports, and related measurement tools directly and/or in partnership with analytics, technology, and reporting teams.


* Gather, organize, analyze, and interpret DPOM\-related data using platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, Jira Align, Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, ChatGPT, or similar tools.


* Prepare recurring reporting and analyses that support MBRs, QBRs, Product Management Hub reviews, and other operating rhythms.


* Translate data, trends, qualitative feedback, and product\-team observations into clear findings, risks, and recommendations.


* Monitor data quality, reporting consistency, and usability of measurement outputs and work with appropriate partners to resolve issues.


**Product Management Maturity and Artifact Quality**


* Conduct and support product management maturity assessments using established DPOM frameworks and assessment approaches.


* Evaluate product management practices and artifacts such as roadmaps, OKRs, product charters, product strategies, discovery practices, prioritization approaches, and value measures.


* Identify recurring maturity gaps, adoption barriers, product management anti\-patterns, and areas where teams may need additional guidance or support.


* Partner with Product Management Catalysts to incorporate field\-based insights and observations from product\-team engagements.


* Synthesize assessment findings so they can inform Product Operations priorities, playbook improvements, training, accelerator workshops, coaching, and other enablement activities.


**Reporting Operations and Continuous Improvement**


* Support integration of DPOM measurement and reporting into established Product Management Hub and enterprise operating rhythms.


* Independently manage assigned reporting processes, analyses, or measurement capabilities and continuously improve their quality, usefulness, and efficiency.


* Partner with Product Operations colleagues to connect measurement insights with improvements to DPOM standards, playbooks, tools, training, and adoption approaches.


* Gather feedback from product teams, leaders, and reporting users to identify opportunities to improve measurement methods, dashboards, reporting experiences, and decision support.


* Identify appropriate opportunities to use AI, automation, and reusable workflows to improve data analysis, artifact assessment, reporting, and insight generation.


**Cross\-Functional Partnership and Product Community Contribution**


* Build trusted relationships with Product Operations, Product Management Catalysts, Digital Product Managers, technology leaders, business partners, analytics and reporting teams, and other cross\-functional stakeholders.


* Influence product\-team partners and leaders through clear communication, preparation, data, and evidence\-based recommendations.


* Facilitate productive discussions about measurement findings, maturity gaps, reporting needs, data limitations, and improvement opportunities.


* Partner with data, analytics, technology, privacy, security, regulatory, and governance specialists when measurement or reporting needs require additional expertise.


* Share reusable insights, examples, and feedback that help improve DPOM measurement practices and strengthen the broader product management community.


**What we expect of you**

Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72\+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.


**A Day in the Life**
=====================

Senior Software Engineer –Full Stack– Endoscopy
  

  

Location – MEIC – Endoscopy
  

  

Careers That Change Lives
  

  

Our space, the medical device and healthcare industry, is rapidly changing. It always has been that way. With remote monitoring, wearables, robotics, AR/VR, telemedicine, and much more, agility and responsiveness are key to our success. Experience what it’s like to work at a company with an exciting product pipeline full of patented inventions driving innovation in the healthcare space.
  

  

Operating Unit
  

  

The Endoscopy Operating Unit has created a business out of disrupting the status quo in the detection, prevention, and treatment of gastrointestinal cancers and chronic diseases. We’ve done this by commercializing transformational technologies that improve patient management and standards of care, while increasing access to our innovations across the globe.
  

  

We improve patient outcomes by empowering every gastroenterologist across the globe with artificial intelligence and disruptive therapeutic technologies. Our talent is the foundation, and we will continue to bring deep clinical expertise, patient\-centric innovation, and powerful digital capabilities to achieve this vision.

* Responsible for the full\-stack development of cloud services that integrate with medical products
* Design, conduct code reviews, implement, debug, web apis, and other AWS cloud services utilizing Dojo, Typescript, .NET, C\+\+, Python.
* Determine design requirements for software systems.
* Evaluate and recommend AWS services, tools, and frameworks based on project requirements.
* Generate documentation for software projects to support regulatory and business needs.
* Participate in all stages of product development: including refining product vision, gathering needs, refining requirements, project planning, system design, coding, testing, release, deployment, and support.
* Utilize experience and education to build high quality, maintainable software following industry design/architectural patterns.
* Use Agile methodologies to manage application development.
* Manage completion of own work assignments and coordinates work with others.
* Continues to strengthen industry knowledge and use that knowledge to improve the quality of our products.
* Ensure that system improvements are successfully implemented and monitored to increase efficiency.
* Additional duties as assigned

**Required Knowledge and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer engineering, Computer Science or a related technical field with 8\+ years of engineering experience
* Minimum 5 years of cloud application software development experience in C\#, .NET Core and React/Angular/DOJO
* Proven track record in designing and implementing enterprise\-scale microservices and distributed systems architectures
* Experience with database development (Postgres SQL)
* Strong understanding of cloud\-native architecture principles, containerization (Kubernetes, Docker), and AWS cloud platform.
* Deep knowledge of API management, event\-driven architecture, and real\-time data processing for scalable systems.
* Knowledge in DevOps methodologies and CI/CD pipelines
* Strong written and verbal communication skills

jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.description:
At **Epiq** , your work contributes to complex, global legal outcomes. You’ll join a values‑driven community where integrity guides decisions, **relentless service** sets the bar, and we **thrive on big challenges** together. We invest in your growth with enterprise‑wide learning and mobility. We celebrate who you are, and we respect life beyond work with flexibility that’s recognized externally. Enabled by modern platforms and AI, **you’ll do the most meaningful work of your career** and see your impact at scale.


**Job Description:**

**Job Summary**
===============

As a Product Owner you are the primary link between stakeholders and delivery teams, balancing business priorities, customer expectations, operational realities, and technical feasibility. You will work closely with CTO’s org, Engineering Leadership, product management and cross\-function teams.


The role calls for a highly motivated, independent thinker who is organized, detail\-oriented, adaptable, and effective at building relationships across diverse teams and stakeholder groups.


Maximize product value by owning the definition, prioritization, and delivery of product capabilities — translating customer, business, operational, and regulatory needs into clear, actionable requirements and measurable outcomes.


**Essential Job Responsibilities**

**Product Vision, Strategy \& Roadmap**

* Define and communicate a product vision aligned with Epiq's strategic objectives and client needs.
* Create, maintain, and prioritize the product roadmap to deliver maximum business value.
* Partner with Product Management and Senior Product Owners to align delivery priorities with the broader product strategy.
* Define minimum viable products, experiments, and incremental delivery approaches that get value to business and customers early.

**Backlog Ownership \& Agile Delivery**

* Own, maintain, and continuously refine the product backlog, prioritizing on value, risk, dependencies, and technical feasibility.
* Translate business needs into epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional requirements. Lead backlog refinement and participate in sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and release planning.
* Provide day\-to\-day requirement clarification and timely product decisions to engineering, QA, and UX, resolving impediments as they arise.

**Hands\-On AI Fluency \& Tooling**

* Use AI tools hands\-on in daily product work — requirement drafting, story refinement, discovery synthesis, research, meeting summarization, usage analysis — and maintain reusable prompt patterns for those workflows.
* Stay current on AI capabilities and emerging patterns, and translate that awareness into concrete product decisions.
* Build lightweight prototypes and clickable concepts using AI\-assisted and low\-code tools to validate ideas before committing engineering capacity.
* Identify and prioritize AI use cases on customer value, feasibility, data readiness, risk, and measurable impact, including where AI can remove manual effort from operational and client\-facing workflows.
* Define evaluation criteria for AI\-enabled features — accuracy, groundedness, latency, cost, confidence thresholds — with human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints and fallback paths for non\-deterministic output.
* Ensure AI usage meets privacy, security, client\-confidentiality, auditability, and responsible\-use requirements, and never treat unvalidated AI output as a final decision or deliverable.

**Stakeholder \& Customer Leadership**

* Serve as the voice of the customer and the liaison between business stakeholders, technical teams, operations, and clients.
* Gather and document business and customer requirements, and facilitate discovery workshops, demonstrations, and feedback sessions.
* Convert customer feedback, usage trends, and operational insight into actionable backlog changes.
* Communicate priorities, roadmap progress, delivery status, risks, and key decisions with clarity.
* Build trusted relationships and influence decisions across organizational levels, from delivery squads to senior leadership.

**Quality, Risk \& Continuous Improvement**

* Embed security, privacy, compliance, information governance, and operational readiness into the product lifecycle.
* Identify and communicate delivery risks, assumptions, dependencies, and constraints early.
* Define success metrics and track adoption, utilization, and business value to guide roadmap and investment decisions.
* Support product documentation, release communications, and enablement materials.
* Validate delivered functionality, lead feature acceptance, and support UAT, release readiness, and deployment.

**Qualifications, Requirements \& Skills**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Advanced degree, or a product management certification (CSPO, PSPO, SAFe PO/PM, CSM, or equivalent).

**Experience**

* 7\+ years as a Product Owner, Product Manager, Business Analyst, Product Analyst role.
* Proven delivery in Agile or Scrum environments, owning enterprise software or SaaS backlogs.
* Demonstrated ability to elicit requirements and translate complex business needs into user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Hands\-on experience with backlog \& delivery\-management tools \- Azure DevOps (Preferred), Jira.
* Practical, day\-to\-day use of AI tools in product, analysis, or delivery work, with specific examples of how they changed your output or decisions.
* Strong stakeholder engagement across business and technology teams, with excellent written and verbal communication.

The Amazon Travel \& Events (AT\&E) Tech team, part of Finance Automation, is driving a multi\-year transformation of the end\-to\-end Travel \& Expense experience for over 500,000 Amazon employees across 64 countries. We are consolidating previously fragmented travel, events, payments, and expense systems into a unified, AI\-powered experience within AtoZ, organized around four interconnected modules: Plan, Book, Pay, and Expense. Our platform leverages machine learning, natural language processing, and GenAI to deliver context\-aware policy guidance, proactive compliance recommendations, fraud detection, and sustainability intelligence embedded into employee workflows. You will build virtual payment capabilities and central card automation that reduce out\-of\-pocket employee spend and target zero manual reconciliation. You will develop AI/ML\-powered fraud detection models that automate the majority of investigation checks and support transaction\-based detection across expanding payment avenues. You will build a single\-source T\&E analytics platform providing real\-time spend insights, policy violation tracking, and cost optimization visibility for managers and finance partners.

jobs.description:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. Let’s transform the future of fitness—together!


Our Values

**Best Life**


We believe great work begins with great people. That’s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work—because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact.

**Growth Mindset**


We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally.

**One Team**


From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive.


**What You'll Do**
------------------

 **Lead the service transformation teams**


Build and manage small, high\-ownership squads responsible for converging duplicated product capabilities into shared, domain\-oriented services. Own the delivery cadence, quality, and predictability of a multi\-year transformation executed in steady quarterly increments with clear boundaries, owners, and cutover plans.

**Turn architecture into shipped services**


Partner with principal engineers and staff engineers to translate target architecture, service boundaries, migration seams, and compatibility strategies into sequenced, executable plans your teams can implement safely. Your job is to make the architecture real: prioritized, staffed, de\-risked, and delivered.

**Establish the base service tier**


Drive the standards for how shared services are designed, contracted, versioned, documented, and consumed, so that every ABC application — and the AI agents and partners building on top of them — can rely on one consistent capability layer. Ensure services are designed for both human and machine consumption from day one, with structured contracts that agents can use reliably.

**Protect compatibility and business continuity**


Convergence only counts if customers never feel it. Lead teams through incremental strangler\-style migrations, staged cutovers, dual\-running periods, and post\-cutover hypercare. Existing behavior, reporting, and integrations keep working until each consumer has safely moved.

**Modernize the application foundations**


Guide the movement of business logic out of legacy, database\-centric implementations into testable, cloud\-native services on our target stack. Retire duplicated builds, legacy dependencies, and aging infrastructure as consumers cut over.

**Raise the bar for engineering quality**


Build quality in as a system, not a stage. Establish a software\-factory approach where every change moves through automated validation loops — layered validators for scope, contracts, parity, runtime behavior, and user experience — that produce evidence of correctness rather than claims of completion. Design the pipeline so that failures are detected, diagnosed, and corrected in\-loop before work integrates, and so that each converged service ships with a durable, inspectable evidence trail. The goal is simple: ship quality software, quickly.

**Drive AI\-native ways of working**


Enable your engineers to use AI across code comprehension, design exploration, implementation, migration analysis, test generation, and documentation. Turn promising individual uses into repeatable team practices, so a small squad can credibly take on a portfolio\-scale transformation.


Make AI the way your team works: engineers direct agents across code comprehension, design exploration, implementation, migration analysis, test generation, and documentation, and the factory's validation gates — not manual inspection — prove every change correct. Turn what works into repeatable factory practices, so a small squad can credibly take on a portfolio\-scale transformation.

**Hire and grow strong engineers**


Recruit, coach, and develop engineers who are comfortable working across legacy code and modern service design. Set clear expectations, give honest feedback, and build a culture of ownership, craft, and follow\-through.

**Partner across the program**


Work closely with product, program leadership, principal engineering, SRE, security, and data teams to sequence domains by customer impact and technical dependency, surface risk early, and keep cross\-team commitments visible and managed.

**What This Is Not**


This is not an architecture\-only or people\-only role. You are expected to engage credibly with design and delivery detail, challenge weak technical assumptions, and be accountable for outcomes — while your engineers own the code.


This is not a greenfield platform build. The value of this work is measured by safely converging live, revenue\-critical systems onto shared services, not by producing new frameworks. Decisions must balance long\-term platform quality with migration safety, business value, and the realities of changing production applications.


This is not a big\-bang rebuild or a customer migration program. The transformation is evolutionary: systems stay releasable throughout, and customers experience better capabilities, not disruptive migration events.

Substantial experience leading backend or platform teams delivering complex, high\-throughput production systems, with direct accountability for delivery, quality, and team health.

**Service transformation depth**


Experience decomposing monoliths, extracting services, and defining domain boundaries, ownership models, and migration strategies within complex existing environments — and delivering those migrations to production.

**AI Ops Application Operations Lead**
======================================


**Role Overview**
-----------------



The AI Ops Application Operations Lead owns the production lifecycle of agentic coding applications, plugins, and skills across Zeta. The role helps teams move high\-value prototypes into production and keeps applications reliable, useful, governed, and measurable after launch.



This role partners closely with application owners, AI Operations, IT, Security, and other technical teams. Its primary focus is production readiness, lifecycle and release management, feedback loops, and clear visibility into adoption, performance, and business impact.



The ideal candidate combines application operations, technical program management, and product fluency. They do not need to be the primary developer for every application, but they must be comfortable working with AI\-assisted development tools, understanding application architecture, translating business needs into technical requirements, and coordinating work across stakeholders.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


### **Production Readiness and Launch**


* Partner with owners of agenticly coded applications to assess whether an application is ready to move from prototype to production.
* Establish and manage a consistent production\-readiness process covering security, privacy, data access, architecture, user experience, support, monitoring, and documentation.
* Identify launch risks, dependencies, and gaps, and coordinate the work required to address them.
* Connect application owners with IT, Security, Data, Legal, and other teams involved in production approval and deployment.
* Develop launch plans, readiness checklists, support models, and ownership documentation for each application.
* Ensure applications have clear business objectives, target users, success measures, and accountable owners before launch.

### **Application Operations and Lifecycle Management**


* Manage the ongoing operational health of production applications.
* Maintain a prioritized backlog of fixes, enhancements, and technical improvements based on direction from the application owner.
* Coordinate application updates, testing, release management, and communication to users.
* Help ensure applications remain compatible with changes to models, APIs, enterprise systems, data sources, and security requirements.
* Establish clear escalation paths for defects, incidents, access issues, and performance concerns.

### **Feedback, Adoption, and Continuous Improvement**


* Help application owners establish structured feedback loops with users.
* Collect and organize user feedback, feature requests, defects, and usage insights.
* Translate feedback into clear product requirements and backlog items.
* Support application owners in prioritizing improvements based on user value, business impact, risk, and effort.
* Coordinate user testing and validation before major releases.
* Identify common patterns across applications that could inform shared standards, reusable components, or broader AI Ops priorities.

### **Measurement and Analytics**


* Develop and maintain dashboards that provide application owners with visibility into adoption, usage, reliability, performance, and business outcomes.
* Define appropriate metrics for each application, including active users, usage frequency, task completion, response quality, errors, latency, user satisfaction, and estimated time or cost savings.
* Monitor application health and surface risks, adoption gaps, and improvement opportunities.
* Partner with application owners to review performance regularly and agree on actions.
* Help determine whether applications should be expanded, redesigned, consolidated, or retired based on evidence.

* Apply AI Ops standards for application development, production readiness, responsible AI, security, documentation, and measurement.
* Help create reusable templates, checklists, playbooks, and operating procedures for agentic coding applications.
* Support the development of a governed application portfolio and inventory.
* Ensure applications have clear ownership, approved data access, defined user groups, and appropriate controls.
* Promote consistency across applications while allowing teams to move quickly and iterate.

**Key Outcomes**
----------------



Success in this role will be measured by:


* Increased percentage of high\-value prototypes successfully moved into production.
* Reduced time from prototype completion to production launch.
* Stronger production readiness and fewer post\-launch issues.
* Clear ownership and support models for every production application.
* Consistent visibility into application adoption, reliability, and business impact.
* Faster response to user feedback and application issues.

  


* Increased adoption and sustained usage of production applications.
* A well\-managed portfolio of applications aligned to business priorities and enterprise standards.

jobs.description:
**Role description**  

ServiceNow Business Analyst


**Experience:** 5\-7 Years

  


Job Summary



We are seeking an experienced **ServiceNow Business Analyst** to support the ongoing enhancement and optimization of the ServiceNow platform. The ideal candidate will play a key role in gathering and documenting business requirements, analyzing defects and enhancement requests, managing product backlogs, supporting solution design, and ensuring successful delivery of ServiceNow capabilities.



The candidate will act as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring business requirements are translated into effective ServiceNow solutions while supporting Agile delivery, testing, and release activities.



Key Responsibilities


### **Business Analysis \& Stakeholder Engagement**


* Partner with business stakeholders, Product Owners, development teams, architects, and operational teams to understand business objectives and requirements.
* Analyze defects, enhancement requests, and new ServiceNow capability requirements.
* Lead discovery workshops, requirement gathering sessions, process walkthroughs, and solution discussions.
* Serve as the primary liaison between business and technical teams.
* Assess business impacts and support stakeholder communication throughout the project lifecycle.

### **Requirements Gathering \& Documentation**


* Elicit, document, and maintain:
	+ Business Requirements
	+ Functional Requirements
	+ User Stories
	+ Acceptance Criteria
	+ Business Rules
	+ Process Flows
	+ Data Requirements
	+ Integration Requirements
	+ Non\-Functional Requirements
* Translate business needs into clear, actionable user stories for ServiceNow development teams.
* Maintain end\-to\-end requirements traceability from analysis through development, testing, and deployment.
* Produce high\-quality documentation supporting project governance and delivery activities.

### **Process Analysis \& Solution Design**


* Analyze existing ServiceNow processes and identify opportunities for optimization and automation.
* Support design and enhancement of:
	+ Case Creation \& Categorization
	+ Case Lifecycle Management
	+ Assignment \& Routing
	+ Priorities \& Entitlements
	+ SLA Management \& Escalations
	+ Customer Communications
	+ Agent Workspace Processes
	+ Customer Portals \& Self\-Service Capabilities
	+ Reports \& Dashboards
* Collaborate with architects and developers to validate solution approaches and ensure alignment with business goals.

### **Agile Delivery \& Backlog Management**


* Participate in backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews, demos, and retrospectives.
* Work closely with Product Owners to prioritize requirements and manage the product backlog.
* Provide functional clarification during development activities.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives across Agile delivery processes.

### **Testing \& Release Support**


* Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) planning and execution.
* Define and review test scenarios, acceptance criteria, and business test cases.
* Assist in defect management, root cause analysis, and issue resolution.
* Coordinate business sign\-off activities.
* Support release planning, deployment readiness, and post\-release validation activities.


Required Qualifications


* 5\-7 years of overall experience with relevant Business Analysis experience.
* Experience working on **ServiceNow** or comparable enterprise workflow platforms.
* Strong expertise in requirements elicitation, process analysis, and stakeholder management.
* Proven experience creating:
	+ BRDs
	+ FRDs
	+ User Stories
	+ Acceptance Criteria
	+ Process Maps
	+ Functional Documentation
* Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies and delivery frameworks.
* Experience managing product backlogs and participating in sprint ceremonies.
* Functional understanding of ServiceNow platform capabilities and modules.
* Experience supporting UAT, defect management, and release activities.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and facilitation abilities.


Preferred Skills


* Experience with ServiceNow modules such as:
	+ Customer Service Management (CSM)
	+ IT Service Management (ITSM)
	+ Human Resources Service Delivery (HRSD)
* Understanding of integrations, APIs, and enterprise application ecosystems.
* Experience with reporting, dashboards, metrics, and KPI definition.
* Familiarity with ServiceNow platform architecture and data models.
* Exposure to ServiceNow governance and best practices.

### **Preferred Certifications**


* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA)
* ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS)
* CBAP, CCBA, PMI\-PBA, or equivalent Business Analysis certifications


Soft Skills


* Strong analytical and critical thinking mindset.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to facilitate discussions across business and technical teams.
* Strong presentation and documentation capabilities.
* Proactive approach to problem\-solving and continuous improvement.
* Ability to work independently in fast\-paced Agile environments.
* Strong collaboration and relationship\-building skills.
* Ability to challenge, refine, and validate business requirements effectively.


Education



Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.

jobs.description:
**Life at UiPath**
 The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category\-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.
   

  

 To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self\-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast\-moving, fast\-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.
   

  

 Could that be you?
   

  

**Your mission**
 You'll own one of the platform layers that powers agentic automation. This is a layer that every other product on the platform \- agents, workflows, and RPA \- depends on to do its job. Your charter is to make it the obvious, trusted choice for developers and customers in the agentic era, and to prove that value with real production adoption.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on role that pairs high autonomy with high accountability. You will set the vision, own the roadmap, get into the technical design with engineering, sit in customer conversations directly, and carry your story all the way into the field.
   

  

**The platform you'll shape**
 You'll join the team building the foundational layers of UiPath's agentic platform, the layers every agent, process, and workflow depends on.
   

  

* Data Fabric \- the data and context layer. Gives agents and workflows governed, real\-time access to enterprise data, modeling raw records into business entities and a shared semantic layer automations can reason over. The work ahead: turning data into connected context agents can navigate.
* Human\-in\-the\-Loop \- the human\-judgment layer. Whenever an agent, process, or workflow needs a person to review, approve, or handle an exception, it brings the right human in: designing the review interface, routing the task, and delivering it wherever people work. The work ahead: making it first\-class for the agentic era.


**What You'll Do At UiPath**
* Own the vision and roadmap for your platform layer, making sharp tradeoff decisions on complex, ambiguous problems, and proposing a clear path forward rather than just surfacing the ambiguity.
* Drive go\-to\-market. Partner with marketing and sales on positioning, enablement, and demos; create demand and get your wins in front of the field and customers.
* Be the customer's champion. Engage directly in account conversations, get deep into real scenarios, and turn what you learn into validated use cases and roadmap decisions.

jobs.description:
**Role** 
 \- Senior Product Manager, Fleet Management Systems (FMS)
 



**Location** 
 \- BLR/GGN
 



  





**About the Role** 




 Delhivery's freight network operates across thousands of vehicles, vendors, customers, and trips every day. Orion and our Fleet Management Systems sit at the center of this ecosystem—connecting demand creation, supply allocation, procurement, trip execution, tracking, documentation, and financial closure.
 



 As Senior Product Manager for FMS, you will own products that make freight operations faster, more automated, and more efficient. You will work at the intersection of customers, operations, supply, engineering, data, and AI—simplifying complex workflows and progressively moving them from manual coordination to intelligent, system\-driven execution.
 



 This is a high\-ownership role for someone who enjoys solving complicated operational problems and turning them into scalable products.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 



* Own the roadmap, not just the backlog — Define product strategy and roadmap across freight and fleet workflows from demand/indent creation and supply\-demand matching to trip execution, tracking, documentation, and closure. Define clear business and product KPIs and own outcomes.
* Automate operations using AI — Identify workflows currently dependent on calls, emails, WhatsApp, spreadsheets, or manual decision\-making and redesign them using AI agents, workflow automation, and intelligent recommendations.
* Go deep into freight operations — Understand how customers raise demand, how supply teams source vehicles, how vendors bid and allocate capacity, and how trips are executed on ground. Spend time with operations, vendors, drivers, and customers to understand where systems diverge from reality.
* Drive measurable operational outcomes — Use data to identify bottlenecks and measure improvements in metrics such as turnaround time, automation/adoption, vehicle placement, tracking compliance, vendor performance, and operational productivity.
* Build for scale and reliability — Partner closely with engineering and architecture teams to design systems that can handle complex workflows, integrations, real\-time events, and large transaction volumes without creating operational fragility.
* Drive execution across teams — Work closely with engineering, operations, supply, business, finance, and external partners. Navigate competing priorities, make trade\-offs, and take initiatives from problem discovery through rollout and adoption.



  





**What You Bring** 



* 4\+ years of product management experience, preferably in logistics, supply chain, fleet management, marketplaces, B2B platforms, or a fast\-paced internet company.
* Strong product fundamentals with demonstrated ability to take ambiguous operational problems, structure them, quantify their impact, and translate them into scalable products.
* Strong operational instinct—you are comfortable understanding workflows on the ground rather than designing products only from meeting rooms.
* Hands\-on SQL and data skills—you should be comfortable pulling and analysing your own data, building funnels, identifying failure patterns, and using data to challenge assumptions.
* Practical fluency with modern AI tooling—LLMs, prompt engineering, agentic workflows, RAG, and AI\-assisted development tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar environments.
* Strong systems thinking. You can reason across workflows involving customers, vendors, vehicles, drivers, payments, documents, APIs, and multiple internal systems rather than optimizing one screen in isolation.
* Ability to influence across teams without relying on authority and to drive adoption after the product has shipped.



  





**Why This Role** 




 Freight operations have traditionally depended heavily on people coordinating through calls, messages, spreadsheets, and fragmented systems. At Delhivery's scale, the opportunity is to fundamentally change that.
 



 FMS is evolving from a system that records freight operations into a platform that can increasingly understand demand, recommend decisions, automate coordination, and manage execution.
 



 This role gives you the opportunity to build that transformation at scale—combining logistics, marketplaces, data, and AI to redefine how freight moves.

Alexa Smart Properties enables enterprise customers to deploy Alexa in their managed properties like hotels, senior living homes, vacation rentals, hospitals, and more, transforming how businesses engage with their customers and streamline staff processes. jobs.description:
**Why N\-able**
 At N\-able, we’re not just helping businesses be secure —we’re redefining what it means to be cyber resilient. Our end\-to\-end platform blends AI\-powered capabilities and flexible tech stacks, so customers can manage, secure, and recover with confidence. But the real power behind it all? Our people. We’re a global crew of N\-ablites, who love solving complex problems, sharing knowledge, and delivering solutions that actually make a difference. If you're into meaningful work, fast growth, and a team that’s got your back, you’ll be surrounded by people who believe in what they do—and in you.
   

  

 We're hiring a Principal Product Manager to own a core area of the
 **Adlumin XDR/MDR** 
 portfolio — its strategy, roadmap, and delivery, leading initiatives in AI DLC model. N\-able PMs are full\-stack PMs. You'll partner deeply with engineering on what gets built and why, but the job doesn't stop at the backlog. You're expected to know the threat landscape, the competition, and where the technology is heading, and to bring that back into decisions others can act on. You'll be in front of partners and customers regularly and trusted to run your area with limited supervision.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for your area of the Adlumin XDR/MDR platform, plus the full lifecycle from ideation to launch: market research, product definition, roadmap planning, and go\-to\-market.
* Translate detection, response, and security operations problems into clear product requirements — and defend the tradeoffs behind them.
* Partner day to day with engineering, data science, and the SOC to deliver capabilities that measurably improve detection quality, response time, and analyst efficiency.
* Run continuous discovery: talk to MSP partners, internal IT teams, SOC analysts, and prospects; separate what people ask for from what they actually need.
* Maintain a live view of the competitive landscape (XDR, MDR, SIEM, EDR, SecOps) and the trends reshaping it, and turn it into positioning and roadmap decisions rather than slideware.
* Define and track the success metrics for your area — adoption, retention, efficacy, unit economics — and act when they move the wrong way.
* Work with product marketing, sales, and service delivery on launches, enablement, and pricing/packaging inputs.
* Apply AI across your workflow and the product: use AI\-assisted development practices to move from problem to spec to working software faster, and set the bar for how the team does this.
* Mentor junior product managers and raise the bar for craft across the team.


**What You'll Bring**
* 6\+ years in product management, with meaningful time on technical B2B or security products.
* A driver's operating style. Self\-motivated, comfortable with ambiguity, effective under loose supervision. You decide, you communicate, you follow through.
* Strong product sense. Good instincts for what to build, what to cut, and what “good” looks like for a security practitioner under time pressure.
* Breadth across cybersecurity, with depth in at least two domains(cloud security, identity, endpoint, network, email, vulnerability management)


**Big Pluses**
* Hands\-on experience with XDR, SIEM, SOAR, EDR, or SOC operations \- as a product manager, practitioner, or analyst.
* Security certifications (Security\+, CISSP, cloud security certs) or a background in security engineering or incident response.
* Experience building AI\-powered product capabilities in a security context.
* Practical experience using or experimenting with AI DLC approaches and tooling \- spec\-driven development frameworks such as GitHub Spec Kit, AI coding agents, prototype\-first workflows.


**Purple Perks**
* Group Medical , Personal Accident \& Term life coverage
* Generous PTO and observed holidays
* 2 Paid VoluNteer Days per year
* Employee Stock Purchase Program
* FuN\-raising opportunities as part of our giving program
* N\-ablite Learning – custom learning experience as part of our investment in you
* The Way We Work – our hybrid working model based on trust and flexibility


**About N\-able**
 At N\-able, Inc. (NYSE: NABL), we are a global software company that turns IT possibilities into capabilities. That means we partner with technology leaders who support companies around the world by offering secure infrastructure and tools to navigate their evolving IT needs. We build strong relationships with our customers to help them thrive at every stage of growth, and at the heart of this effort is our network of N\-ablites—a global team of extraordinary, diverse creators who are dedicated to making a difference in how our partners do IT.

jobs.title: Senior Product Owner, Workday HCM & Onboarding
jobs.description:
**Position Overview**
 The
 **Senior Product Owner** 
 is an experienced, functionally deep Workday professional who owns one or more Workday modules end\-to\-end on behalf of Revantage and its PortCos. This is not a passive coordination role — it is an active, hands\-on domain mastery role. You are the subject\-matter expert, the decision\-maker, the stakeholder champion, and the product strategist for your assigned module(s). You will work across a complex multi\-PortCo environment, running user forums, managing the release roadmap, driving adoption, and continuously finding ways to extract more value from the platform.
   

  

 This role is specifically focused on Core HCM, Onboarding \& Security. Additional module expertise is a plus. This role has a defined growth path: as the team matures, the Product Owner will take on line management responsibility for an Associate Product Owner, growing into a player\-manager who both delivers and develops.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Domain Ownership \& Functional Mastery**
* Own your assigned Workday module(s): Core HCM, Security and Onbaording end\-to\-end — from strategy and design through configuration, testing, deployment, and ongoing optimization.
* Develop and maintain deep functional expertise in your domain(s), staying current with Workday product updates, roadmap changes, and community best practices.
* Serve as the primary point of contact and escalation resource for your module area across all PortCos.
* Maintain comprehensive knowledge of how your module(s) interact with upstream and downstream systems and processes — and design solutions with those dependencies in mind.
* Think beyond Workday: identify complementary or supplementary technologies that could enhance capability in your domain — whether that is AI\-powered tools, third\-party integrations, or adjacent platforms.


**PortCo Engagement \& Stakeholder Management**
* Build and maintain strong relationships with HR leaders, operations teams, and business stakeholders across multiple PortCos.
* Act as a trusted advisor — understanding each PortCo's unique workforce model, business context, and HR priorities.
* Run structured Product Owner forums, working groups, and user communities to surface requirements, share updates, and drive alignment.
* Manage competing priorities across PortCos with transparency — communicating trade\-offs, timelines, and decisions clearly to all stakeholders.
* Facilitate requirements workshops and design sessions, translating business needs into clear, actionable Workday solutions.


**Roadmap \& Release Ownership**
* Own and maintain the product roadmap for your module(s) — balancing strategic enhancements, PortCo\-driven requirements, bug fixes, and Workday release adoption.
* Evaluate every Workday bi\-annual release for impact and opportunity within your domain — leading opt\-in decisions, testing, and rollout planning.
* Prioritize the backlog in collaboration with stakeholders, the Functional Architect, and People Technology leadership.
* Ensure all enhancements are delivered with appropriate change management, training, and communications to end users and HR teams.
* Track and report on the delivery and benefit realization of roadmap initiatives.


**Hands\-On Delivery**
* Remain hands\-on with Workday configuration in your module area — able to review, validate, and contribute to configuration work alongside the Associate Product Owner.
* Lead user acceptance testing (UAT) for enhancements and releases within your domain.
* Review and approve design documents, configuration specifications, and test plans before deployment.
* Support the Associate Product Owner(s) in day\-to\-day delivery, providing guidance, review, and quality oversight.


**Ecosystem \& Innovation Thinking**
* Continuously evaluate the HR technology landscape for innovations relevant to your module area — e.g., AI in recruiting, manager effectiveness tools, payroll analytics.
* Propose and build the business case for technology enhancements or new tool adoption where Workday alone does not fully meet business needs.
* Collaborate with vendors (Workday, Paradox, HiredScore, Peakon, etc.) to stay ahead of product developments and advocate for Revantage's priorities.


**Team Development**
* In the near term, work closely with and provide functional guidance to the Associate Product Owner(s) aligned to your module area.
* As the team grows, take on formal line management responsibility for your Associate Product Owner — supporting their development, performance, and career growth.


**Required Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of Workday functional experience with deep, hands\-on expertise in at least two Workday modules.
* Demonstrated experience owning a Workday module in a production environment — including enhancements, releases, stakeholder management, and roadmap ownership.
* Experience working in a multi\-entity, multi\-PortCo, or shared\-services HR technology model.
* Strong understanding of Workday business process configuration, security roles, reporting, and calculated fields.
* Proven ability to engage and influence senior HR stakeholders without direct authority.
* Experience running forums, steering committees, or user communities across a distributed stakeholder base.
* Global Workday implementation or support experience — able to navigate multi\-jurisdiction complexity.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills — able to translate technical concepts for business audiences and vice versa.


**Module\-specific Experience (by Role)**
 Depending on the specific Product Owner role, candidates should bring deep expertise in one or more of the following clusters:
   

  

* Core HCM, Onboarding \& Workday Help: Org design, job architecture, business process configuration, worker data, Workday Help case management.

jobs.description:
**Project Role** 
 : Public Services \- Salesforce Product Owner
   

  

**Project Role Description** 
 : We are seeking an experienced and influential Salesforce Product Owner with strong public services domain expertise. In this role, you will own the product backlog, prioritize features and releases, and translate business needs into actionable Salesforce requirements that support provider operations, provider portals, member portals, broker portals, and broader healthcare workflows. You will work closely with business leaders, architects, administrators, and delivery teams to maximize business value, ensure release readiness, and drive user adoption.
   

  

**Must have** 
 : Product Ownership / Business Analysis / Consulting Experience
   

  

**Good to have** 
 : Salesforce certifications and Agile / Product Owner certifications
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities: \-**
* Own and prioritize the Salesforce product backlog, ensuring alignment with business goals, healthcare workflows, and compliance requirements.
* Partner with business stakeholders, SMEs, architects, and delivery teams to define product vision, roadmap, release priorities, and measurable outcomes.
* Translate complex business needs into epics, features, user stories, process flows, and acceptance criteria for Salesforce solutions.
* Lead backlog refinement, sprint planning support, requirement clarification, and user acceptance readiness to enable smooth delivery.
* Make day\-to\-day product decisions, resolve requirement ambiguities, and balance scope, timeline, and value during delivery.
* Define success metrics, monitor adoption and business value realization, and recommend enhancements based on user feedback and performance trends.
* Maintain clear documentation for user stories, business rules, release notes, process changes, and support handover materials.
* Drive stakeholder communication, sprint reviews, demos, training alignment, and change management activities for successful adoption.
* Adhere to Salesforce best practices.
* Acquire skills that have utility across Health industry groups.


**Required Qualifications**
* Proven experience as a Salesforce Product Owner, Senior Business Analyst, or Functional Consultant in Agile environments for 2\-3 Salesforce implementations with Public Service clients.
* Strong understanding of Public Sector workflows, terminology, regulatory requirements.
* Hands\-on experience in backlog management, user story writing, acceptance criteria definition, prioritization, and sprint ceremonies.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, stakeholder management, prioritization, and collaboration skills.
* Cross\-cultural competence with an ability to thrive in a dynamic environment.
* Certifications (e.g., Salesforce Admin, Business Analyst, Scrum Product Owner / CSPO / SAFe POPM) are a plus.
* Education: 15 years of full\-time education (bachelor's degree or equivalent required).


**Preferred Skills**
* Experience with Digital Front Door, CRM, Contact Center, Care Management, or related public\-sector workflows.
* Firsthand experience with Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Public Sector Solutions, Experience Cloud, and ideally OmniStudio implementations in Salesforce.
* Familiarity with tools like Jira, Confluence, or Azure DevOps.
* Ability to collaborate with distributed and cross\-geographical teams.
* Exposure to release planning, user adoption tracking, and change management.

jobs.description:
Overview:
**Sr. Business Systems Analyst, People \& Internal Systems**


HealthEdge is in a period of rapid growth and consolidation following recent mergers. The Business Technology team exists to make sure the systems that power our business keep up — not just running, but evolving alongside the teams that depend on them.


We're hiring a Sr. Business Systems Analyst to join our Business Technology Team.


You'll bring deep expertise in enterprise integrations — APIs, middleware, iPaaS. In the near term, you'll have a strong focus on building out and stabilizing integrations as we migrate off legacy systems. This role is designed to grow: more platform ownership, broader systems scope and expanded stakeholder relationships over time.


If you're a technically sharp integrations specialist who thrives on keeping complex system ecosystems healthy, and wants a role with real ownership from day one — this role is for you.

**In This Role, You'll Get To**

* Own the integration layer. Share ownership of our active integrations across payroll, benefits, identity management, finance and more — monitoring health, resolving failures, and improving reliability over time.
* Configure and improve. Work across enterprise systems and with business stakeholders, providing input on business processes, condition rules and security to support evolving needs.
* Automate what shouldn't be manual. Identify and eliminate repetitive work through business process automation, calculated fields, iPaaS tooling, and Claude\-powered workflows.
* Measure what matters. Connect what you build to outcomes — integration uptime, data quality, Claude adoption and usage, process cycle time. Know whether your solution moved the needle and explain impact in business terms, not just technical ones.
* Be the trusted partner. Embed yourself in how teams actually work, surfacing friction before stakeholders have to tell you about it, translating what you find into requirements, and building the case for what needs to change.
* Think in systems. Design solutions for longevity — upstream and downstream, anticipating what breaks three hops down the road, building for scale rather than just solving today's problem.
* Bring an AI\-first lens to the work. Use AI tools, including Claude, to accelerate your own output — analysis, documentation, testing, solution design — and look for opportunities to bring that lens to how the business operates.
* Grow with the team. As HealthEdge scales and the Business Technology team matures, there's real opportunity to expand into broader systems, integrations and AI platform ownership — for the right person who wants to keep growing.
* Build institutional knowledge. Maintain thorough documentation of system configuration, integration architecture, data flows and Claude governance .
**What We're Looking For**

* 5\+ years in business systems, integrations or IT platform roles — with direct, hands\-on experience building and supporting enterprise integrations (APIs, EIB\-style tooling, Core Connectors or similar)
* Strong working knowledge of integration patterns — APIs, SFTP, middleware, SSO and how data moves between enterprise systems — and proven ability to troubleshoot when things break in production
* Hands\-on experience with automation — business process logic, calculated fields, or iPaaS platforms (MuleSoft, Workato, Boomi or similar) — and a track record of reducing manual work
* Experience partnering with business stakeholders to translate requirements into system configuration — you understand both the technical and functional sides of the platforms you own
* Strong data fluency — you validate, interpret and explain data clearly, and understand how system configuration decisions affect what lands downstream
* Comfort with ambiguity — this team is building its own playbook and you'll help write it; you don't need a perfect brief to get started
* Clear communicator who translates technical complexity for business and non\-technical audiences without losing the substance
* Familiarity with data privacy and security frameworks (HIPAA, HITRUST, or similar) as they apply to enterprise data, AI platform usage and cross\-system data flows
* AI\-first by default: you already reach for AI tools in your daily work, experiment on your own, and are genuinely curious about what comes next — not just willing to use AI when asked
